# Capturing data

A capture client sends one `QuestionnaireResponse` per form submission: one filled-in data set
form for one organisation unit and one reporting period, one event of an event program, or one
event of a tracker program stage. A capture endpoint accepts a single response per request -
there is no bundle, no batch, and no partial submission that a later request completes.
Everything the response has to carry is stated by one of the three profiles below, so a client
can be written, and validated, against this guide alone.

| Form kind | Profile | What one response is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Aggregate | [D2AggregateResponse](StructureDefinition-d2-aggregate-response.html) | One data set form, for one organisation unit and one reporting period. |
| Event | [D2EventResponse](StructureDefinition-d2-event-response.html) | One event of an event program, at one organisation unit. |
| Tracker event | [D2TrackerEventResponse](StructureDefinition-d2-tracker-event-response.html) | One event of a tracker program stage, for one enrolled tracked entity. |

## An aggregate response, step by step

The steps are worked against **EPI Stock** (`TuL8IOPzpHh`).

**1. Point at the Questionnaire.** `questionnaire` is the canonical URL of the form being
answered, which is always `http://example.org/fhir/examples/aggregate-minimal/Questionnaire/<dhis2Uid>` - the DHIS2 UID of
the data set, unchanged:

```
"questionnaire": "http://example.org/fhir/examples/aggregate-minimal/Questionnaire/TuL8IOPzpHh"
```

**2. Say which period the values report.** The `D2Period` extension
carries the DHIS2 reporting period: its ISO identifier and its period type, both mandatory, and
optionally the dates that period resolves to. It is what makes the response a DHIS2 report
rather than an undated form. See [Periods](periods.html) for every registered period type and
the ISO grammar each is written in.

```
"extension": [{
  "url": "http://example.org/fhir/examples/aggregate-minimal/StructureDefinition/d2-period",
  "extension": [
    { "url": "iso",    "valueString": "202512" },
    { "url": "type",   "valueCode":   "Monthly" },
    { "url": "period", "valuePeriod": { "start": "2025-12-01", "end": "2025-12-31" } }
  ]
}]
```

**3. Say which kind of form it is.** The `D2FormType` extension is fixed
to `#aggregate` by the profile, coded from `D2FormType_CS`. Send it
anyway - it is what lets a receiver route the response without resolving the Questionnaire.

**4. Name the organisation unit.** `subject` is a reference to the `Location` of the DHIS2
organisation unit the values were captured at, and the profile restricts it to
`D2Location`. Every published unit has one; see
[Registry](registry.html) for the hierarchy and its identifiers.

```
"subject": { "reference": "Location/PMa2VCrupOd" }
```

Written out, that is Kambia (`PMa2VCrupOd`).

**5. Answer one item per `linkId`.** The response mirrors the Questionnaire's item tree, and
every question is addressed by the `linkId` the Questionnaire gave it. There are exactly two
grammars:

- `<dataElementId>` - a data element that is not disaggregated.
- `<dataElementId>.<categoryOptionComboId>` - one cell of a data element disaggregated
  by a non-default category combo. The parent data element is a `#group` item and each option
  combo is a child question under it. That dotted key is exactly the key a DHIS2 data value
  carries, so nothing has to be reconstructed on either side.

| `linkId` | Grammar | Answers | Answer element | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cZnQDuF3IDz.fsFN9T4ck3E` | `<dataElementId>.<categoryOptionComboId>` | Stock PHU discarded BCG / Expired | `valueDecimal` | no |
| `cZnQDuF3IDz.pn1upwnbxfn` | `<dataElementId>.<categoryOptionComboId>` | Stock PHU discarded BCG / Damages | `valueDecimal` | no |
| `cZnQDuF3IDz.TxaWpw1pN5G` | `<dataElementId>.<categoryOptionComboId>` | Stock PHU discarded BCG / VVM Change | `valueDecimal` | no |
| `FvKdfA2SuWI.fsFN9T4ck3E` | `<dataElementId>.<categoryOptionComboId>` | Stock PHU discarded Measles / Expired | `valueDecimal` | no |

**6. Fill in every required question.** An item carrying `required = true` has to be answered.
For a data set that is what a DHIS2 compulsory data element operand means: an operand naming a
data element alone makes the whole question mandatory, every disaggregated cell of it included,
while an operand naming a category option combo too makes only that one cell mandatory. Read
the flag off the Questionnaire rather than inferring it.

**7. Type each answer.** The `value[x]` element an answer lands on is fixed by the data
element's DHIS2 value type - see [the answer typing table](#answer-typing) below.

## An event response, step by step

The steps are worked against **Supervision visit** (`EVTsupVis01`).

An event response follows the same shape, with three differences:

- `D2FormType` is fixed to `#event`, and there is no
  `D2Period` - an event happens at a moment, not over a reporting period.
- `authored` is mandatory: it is when the event occurred, as an R4 `dateTime`. DHIS2 serves
  `occurredAt` without a zone offset, and FHIR requires one on any `dateTime` carrying a time,
  so send `Z` when the stored timestamp is UTC.
- `questionnaire` is `http://example.org/fhir/examples/aggregate-minimal/Questionnaire/<dhis2Uid>` with the UID of the
  event *program*.

```
"questionnaire": "http://example.org/fhir/examples/aggregate-minimal/Questionnaire/EVTsupVis01"
```

| `linkId` | Grammar | Answers | Answer element | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `s46m5MS0hxu.Prlt0C1RF0s` | `<dataElementId>.<categoryOptionComboId>` | BCG doses given / Fixed, &lt;1y | `valueInteger` | no |
| `s46m5MS0hxu.psbwp3CQEhs` | `<dataElementId>.<categoryOptionComboId>` | BCG doses given / Fixed, &gt;1y | `valueInteger` | no |
| `s46m5MS0hxu.V6L425pT3A0` | `<dataElementId>.<categoryOptionComboId>` | BCG doses given / Outreach, &lt;1y | `valueInteger` | no |
| `s46m5MS0hxu.hEFKSsPV5et` | `<dataElementId>.<categoryOptionComboId>` | BCG doses given / Outreach, &gt;1y | `valueInteger` | no |

`status` says how far the capture got. A DHIS2 event status maps onto a
`QuestionnaireResponse.status` one for one:

| DHIS2 event status | `QuestionnaireResponse.status` |
| --- | --- |
| `ACTIVE` | `in-progress` |
| `COMPLETED` | `completed` |
| `OVERDUE` | `completed` |
| `SCHEDULE` | `completed` |
| `SKIPPED` | `stopped` |
| `VISITED` | `completed` |

Anything else reads as `completed`, and an aggregate response is always `completed` - a
reported period is a finished one.

## A tracker event response, step by step

The steps are worked against **ANC follow-up - ANC visit** (`PsAncVisit1`).

A tracker event response answers one stage of a tracker program, for one event of one
enrollment. It follows the event response, with the context an enrolled tracked entity adds:

- `D2FormType` is fixed to `#tracker-event`, and there is no
  `D2Period` - an event happens at a moment, not over a reporting period.
- `authored` is mandatory: it is when the event occurred, the DHIS2 `occurredAt` of the event.
- `questionnaire` is `http://example.org/fhir/examples/aggregate-minimal/Questionnaire/<dhis2Uid>` with the UID of the
  program *stage*, not of the tracker program.

```
"questionnaire": "http://example.org/fhir/examples/aggregate-minimal/Questionnaire/PsAncVisit1"
```

**1. Name the tracked entity.** `subject` is a logical reference: this guide publishes no
`Patient` resource, so the response carries no `reference` and identifies the DHIS2 tracked
entity instead. The tracked entity resolves against DHIS2:

```
"subject": {
  "type": "Patient",
  "identifier": { "system": "http://dhis2.org/fhir/id/tracked-entity", "value": "<trackedEntityUid>" }
}
```

**2. Name the enrollment.** The `D2TrackerEnrollment` extension carries the DHIS2
tracker enrollment the event belongs to, as the enrollment UID:

```
"extension": [{
  "url": "http://example.org/fhir/examples/aggregate-minimal/StructureDefinition/d2-tracker-enrollment",
  "valueIdentifier": { "system": "http://dhis2.org/fhir/id/tracker-enrollment", "value": "<enrollmentUid>" }
}]
```

**3. Name the organisation unit.** `subject` names the tracked entity, so the organisation unit
the event was captured at rides on the `D2OrganisationUnit` extension, as
a reference to that unit's `D2Location`:

```
"extension": [{
  "url": "http://example.org/fhir/examples/aggregate-minimal/StructureDefinition/d2-organisation-unit",
  "valueReference": { "reference": "Location/PMa2VCrupOd" }
}]
```

A client obtains both UIDs from DHIS2 itself - `d2w data tracker enrollment list` lists the
enrollments of a program and the tracked entity each one registers - and resolving them is
outside this guide's scope.

**4. Answer one item per `linkId`.** The stage's questions carry the same two grammars an
aggregate form does, and are typed by the same table.

| `linkId` | Grammar | Answers | Answer element | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DeAncVisNo1` | `<dataElementId>` | ANC visit number | `valueInteger` | yes |
| `DeAncBpSys1` | `<dataElementId>` | ANC systolic blood pressure | `valueInteger` | no |
| `DeAncDanger` | `<dataElementId>` | ANC danger signs present | `valueBoolean` | no |

`status` maps from the DHIS2 event status exactly as it does for an event program.

## Answer typing

Every answer is typed from the DHIS2 value type of the data element the `linkId` names. A
disaggregated cell shares its parent data element's value type, so a `#group` and all its
children are typed alike. A question bound to an option set is a `#choice` whatever its value
type, and answers as a `valueCoding` - see [Coded answers](#coded-answers).

| DHIS2 value type | Item type | Answer element | Literal |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AGE` | `date` | `valueDate` | `YYYY-MM-DD`, the date of birth - DHIS2 renders the age from it, so the date is the captured value. |
| `BOOLEAN` | `boolean` | `valueBoolean` | `true` or `false`, unquoted JSON booleans. |
| `COORDINATE` | `string` | `valueString` | The DHIS2 `[longitude,latitude]` string; no R4 item type expresses a coordinate pair. |
| `DATE` | `date` | `valueDate` | `YYYY-MM-DD`. |
| `DATETIME` | `dateTime` | `valueDateTime` | `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss` plus a zone; DHIS2 stores local time, so send `Z` when you mean UTC. |
| `EMAIL` | `string` | `valueString` | The stored DHIS2 text. |
| `FILE_RESOURCE` | `attachment` | `valueAttachment` | An `Attachment`; the generated examples leave file answers empty rather than invent one. |
| `GEOJSON` | `text` | `valueString` | The GeoJSON document as stored, carried verbatim in the string. |
| `IMAGE` | `attachment` | `valueAttachment` | An `Attachment`; the generated examples leave image answers empty rather than invent one. |
| `INTEGER` | `integer` | `valueInteger` | A whole number; the item's `minValue` / `maxValue` state any bound the value type carries. |
| `INTEGER_NEGATIVE` | `integer` | `valueInteger` | A whole number; the item's `minValue` / `maxValue` state any bound the value type carries. |
| `INTEGER_POSITIVE` | `integer` | `valueInteger` | A whole number; the item's `minValue` / `maxValue` state any bound the value type carries. |
| `INTEGER_ZERO_OR_POSITIVE` | `integer` | `valueInteger` | A whole number; the item's `minValue` / `maxValue` state any bound the value type carries. |
| `LETTER` | `string` | `valueString` | The stored DHIS2 text. |
| `LONG_TEXT` | `text` | `valueString` | The stored DHIS2 text. |
| `MULTI_TEXT` | `string` | `valueCoding` | Option-set bound, and the item repeats: send one `answer` per selection, each a `valueCoding` into the set's CodeSystem. |
| `NUMBER` | `decimal` | `valueDecimal` | A decimal number. |
| `ORGANISATION_UNIT` | `reference` | `valueReference` | `Location/<organisationUnitId>` - the Location this guide publishes for that unit. |
| `PERCENTAGE` | `decimal` | `valueDecimal` | A decimal between 0 and 100, the bounds the item's `minValue` / `maxValue` state. |
| `PHONE_NUMBER` | `string` | `valueString` | The stored DHIS2 text. |
| `REFERENCE` | `string` | `valueString` | The bare DHIS2 UID - this guide publishes no FHIR resource for the referenced object. |
| `TEXT` | `string` | `valueString` | The stored DHIS2 text. |
| `TIME` | `time` | `valueTime` | `hh:mm:ss` - seconds are mandatory in FHIR even where DHIS2 captures `hh:mm`. |
| `TRACKER_ASSOCIATE` | `string` | `valueString` | The bare DHIS2 UID - this guide publishes no FHIR resource for the referenced object. |
| `TRUE_ONLY` | `boolean` | `valueBoolean` | Always `true` - DHIS2 stores no false value, so an unticked box is simply absent. |
| `UNIT_INTERVAL` | `decimal` | `valueDecimal` | A decimal between 0 and 1, the bounds the item's `minValue` / `maxValue` state. |
| `URL` | `url` | `valueUri` | An absolute URI. |
| `USERNAME` | `string` | `valueString` | The stored DHIS2 text. |

A numeric question whose value type *is* a constraint - a positive integer, a percentage, a
unit interval - carries that constraint as `minValue` / `maxValue` extensions on the item, so a
client can range-check before sending rather than after being rejected.

## Coded answers

A question bound to a DHIS2 option set answers as a `valueCoding`:

- `system` is the canonical URL of that option set's generated `CodeSystem`.
- `code` is the concept code exactly as this guide generated it - do not re-derive it from the
  DHIS2 option, and do not send a display-only string.

Both DHIS2 identifiers of the option ride along on the concept, as concept properties, so a
client holding either the UID or the DHIS2 code can resolve the concept from the CodeSystem
without a second lookup. [Terminology](terminology.html) catalogs every published option set
and [Identifiers](identifiers.html) states the property URIs.

A `MULTI_TEXT` question captures several selections at once: the item carries
`repeats = true`, and the response sends one `answer` entry per selection, each its own
`valueCoding`.

## Validating before you send

Validate every response against its profile with the standard FHIR validator before sending
it. The three profiles are the contract, and the examples published beside them are validated on
every regeneration of this guide, so a response that validates locally is a response the
receiver will accept:

- [D2AggregateResponse](StructureDefinition-d2-aggregate-response.html)
  for a data set submission.
- [D2EventResponse](StructureDefinition-d2-event-response.html) for an
  event submission.
- [D2TrackerEventResponse](StructureDefinition-d2-tracker-event-response.html)
  for a tracker event submission.

[D2CaptureServer](CapabilityStatement-d2-capture-server.html) states
the interactions a server accepting these responses supports: one `create` per
`QuestionnaireResponse` against any of the three profiles, plus read and search over the
Questionnaires, terminology, and registry a client resolves a form from.
